description: Synthetic Forge Trail developer-tool release used only for timing, not accuracy scoring.

changes.subject: feat: filter task history by execution outcome
changes.body: Operators can select completed or failed tasks in the history view.

changes.subject: fix: retain task labels after importing a workspace
changes.body: An imported workspace preserves its task labels instead of discarding them.

changes.subject: feat: export job durations as a table
changes.body: A local export contains job names and elapsed durations for later inspection.

changes.subject: fix: display timestamps in the chosen locale
changes.body: History timestamps honor the user's selected locale.

changes.subject: feat: pause queued tasks before execution
changes.body: Pausing a queue stops new tasks from starting while active tasks finish.

changes.subject: fix: prevent two workers from claiming the same job
changes.body: The scheduler grants an exclusive claim before a worker starts a job.

changes.subject: feat: validate workflow references before saving
changes.body: A missing workflow reference is reported before the workspace is saved.

changes.subject: fix: keep diagnostic output after a task crashes
changes.body: Task failure preserves the log captured before the crash.

changes.subject: feat: open recent workspaces from the launcher
changes.body: The launcher lists recent workspace paths for quick reopening.

changes.subject: fix: reject output paths outside the selected directory
changes.body: Task-generated files must remain beneath the configured output root.

changes.subject: feat: show total queued work in the status bar
changes.body: The status bar displays the number of tasks still waiting to run.

changes.subject: fix: release temporary file handles after cancellation
changes.body: Cancelled tasks close temporary file handles.

changes.subject: feat: allow a custom task retry delay
changes.body: Workspace settings specify the waiting period between retries.

changes.subject: fix: preserve non-ASCII workspace names in exports
changes.body: Exported workspace names keep their Unicode characters.

changes.subject: feat(api)!: remove deprecated task execution routes
changes.body: BREAKING CHANGE: integrations must migrate from /tasks/run to /jobs/start.

changes.subject: feat(config)!: rename worker_count to parallelism
changes.body: BREAKING CHANGE: old configurations must replace the worker_count field.

changes.subject: test: add scheduler contention fixtures
docs: explain installation from source
build: consolidate lint configuration
chore: update development fixture names

notes.text: Filter history to see only successful or failed tasks.
Workspace imports keep labels attached to tasks.
Save job names and durations in a table for local analysis.
Timestamps use the selected locale rather than a fixed format.
Pause a queue to hold waiting tasks while ongoing work finishes.
A job can no longer be started by two workers at once.
Saving reports references to workflows that no longer exist.
Diagnostic logs remain available after a task fails.
The launcher provides a list of recently opened workspaces.
Generated output files must stay inside the chosen directory.
Rename worker_count to parallelism when migrating configuration.
